statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-44903 (GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28, GO-2026-5381): in the Prometheus server's legacy web UI (enabled with --enable-feature=old-ui), the histogram heatmap chart did not escape le label values when inserting them into the page, a stored cross-site scripting issue. It affects Prometheus from 2.49.0 and is fixed in 3.5.3 and 3.11.3 (Go module github.com/prometheus/prometheus v0.311.3): https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/security/advisories/GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5381, fix commit https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/commit/38f23b9075ced1de2b82d2dad8b2bebb1ecd5b7d, which changes only the web UI file web/ui/react-app/src/pages/graph/Graph.tsx. We read every metrics-server-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 2026-11-28: 29 builds, 0.8.1-r0 to the current 0.9.1-r2, each for x86_64 and aarch64 (58 packages), each download checked against the size and control checksum in the package index. Each package installs one file, /usr/bin/metrics-server, a statically linked Go program (no ELF interpreter and no dynamic section) built with GOOS=linux and CGO_ENABLED=0, without -trimpath, without the -w linker flag, and with DWARF debug sections in every build; both architectures record the same Go release and module versions in every build. The Go release recorded in each program's build information is: Go 1.25.7 in 0.8.1-r0; Go 1.26.1 in 0.8.1-r1 to 0.8.1-r4; Go 1.26.2 in 0.8.1-r5 to 0.8.1-r7; Go 1.26.3 in 0.8.1-r8 to 0.8.1-r9; Go 1.26.4 in 0.8.1-r10 to 0.8.1-r11; Go 1.26.5 in 0.8.1-r12 to 0.9.0-r1; Go 1.26.6 in 0.9.0-r2; Go 1.26.7 in 0.9.0-r3 to 0.9.0-r4; Go 1.26.8 in 0.9.0-r5 to 0.9.0-r9; Go 1.26.9 in 0.9.0-r10; Go 1.26.10 in 0.9.0-r11 to 0.9.1-r0; Go 1.26.11 in 0.9.1-r1 to 0.9.1-r2. The github.com/prometheus/prometheus version in the Go build information, with no replace directive for that module, is v0.304.2 in 0.8.1-r0 to 0.8.1-r12; v0.313.0 in 0.9.0-r0 to 0.9.0-r12; v0.314.0 in 0.9.1-r0 to 0.9.1-r2; v0.313.0 and v0.314.0 are past the fixed v0.311.3. We listed the function names the Go linker records in each program (its symbol table, read with go tool nm) in every build on both architectures. The only github.com/prometheus/prometheus packages with functions in the program are, by build, 0.8.1-r0 to 0.8.1-r12: model/exemplar, model/histogram, model/labels, model/textparse, prompb/io/prometheus/client; 0.9.0-r0 to 0.9.1-r2: model/exemplar, model/histogram, model/labels, model/textparse, prompb/io/prometheus/client, schema, util/convertnhcb, util/kahansum: the Prometheus metric data model and its exposition-format parsers, with at least 460 functions from the module in every program. No build contains a function from github.com/prometheus/prometheus/web or any of its subpackages, which serve the web UI and embed its scripts, and a byte search of every program finds no github.com/prometheus/prometheus/web name while it finds the github.com/prometheus/prometheus/ prefix at least 1080 times in every program. The web UI, and the heatmap script the fix changes, are not in any published build.

statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-44903 (GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28, GO-2026-5381): the legacy Prometheus web UI heatmap did not escape label values, a stored cross-site scripting issue, fixed in github.com/prometheus/prometheus v0.311.3: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/security/advisories/GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28.
